objective: Retrieve the Warchief's Orders and return them to the Fallen Hero of the Horde.

description: Orders were given by the dispatch commander. We took... took orders. On way to Blasted Lands, ambushed.
Murlocs... Many murlocs... One named Swamp Talker. Took orders from my hands as spear thrust into my skull. East... cave....
completion: It is worse than I imagined. Nineteen of my men could have been spared from the agony which they faced. If only I had not acted so irrationally.
You must help them, <name>! I am powerless to act.
